selection_rule: per_domain_minimum_cumulative_then_union using cross-season mean RMS STI; PM06 excluded per T7 §5.4
aggregation: RMS STI across all outputs within each domain, then mean across XXQL2501/XXQL2502/XXQL2601
sobol_unvalidated_note: XXQL2501 N=64->128 convergence failed thresholds (Spearman 0.85/0.89, Jaccard 0.45/0.60); XXQL2502/XXQL2601 have no cross-scale convergence report. Sobol is treated as screening evidence, not as science_validated; the parameter set is an engineering candidate, not a frozen scientific conclusion.
limitations: A 90% Sobol RMS STI rule controls screening coverage of total-order effects; it does not establish parameter identifiability, equifinality absence, or observation support. Literature, observation coverage, bounds and equifinality diagnostics remain mandatory before bounds are frozen and before posterior claims are made.
